The learned counsel for respondent no. 2 along with respondent no. 2 is present through Video Conferencing (VC).

2. It is the case under Sections 354(A)/509 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC'), this Court deems it appropriate to hear this case through VC since as per law and practice directions,
even the name of the victims is not to be disclosed, therefore, in such cases of sexual assault and under Sections 376/355 of IPC etc.

there cannot be hearings where the arguments are heard, FIRs are read the contents of statements recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. read and the complainants appear through VC where her whereabouts and identity was disclosed publically.
